what_it_is.prose: Bellatrix Aerospace is a Bengaluru-based spacetech startup founded in 2015 by Rohan M Ganapathy (CEO) and Yashas Karanam (COO). Specialises in advanced in-space mobility: electric propulsion (Hall Effect Thrusters) and Orbital Transfer Vehicles. Flagship products: Arka Hall Effect Thruster (HET) family — including the 200W Arka which houses world's first heaterless hollow cathode in space (Jan 2024), and Rudra (higher-power variant). Pushpak Orbital Transfer Vehicle (OTV) — multi-mission platform carrying CubeSats/small sats up to 750 kg, partnered with NSIL (Oct 2024) to integrate Pushpak into NSIL's future launch missions. Total funding $34.4M; latest $20M Pre-Series B (Mar 2026) led by Cactus Partners. Also partnering with Korean optical payload manufacturer TelePIX on a VLEO demo satellite (launch NET 2028).
